scenarios.label: Happy path
scenarios.description: Real Vault discovery, plan review, report sections and summary.

scenarios.label: Slow streaming
scenarios.description: Happy path with visible response latency and chunked report text.

scenarios.label: Planning failure
scenarios.description: Fails the model during AI Search planning.

scenarios.label: Empty Vault result
scenarios.description: Submits a valid zero-evidence plan without changing the real Vault.

scenarios.label: Vault tool recovery
scenarios.description: Triggers real tool-input validation, observes the error, then recovers.

scenarios.label: Report partial failure
scenarios.description: Planning succeeds, then one report section fails.

scenarios.label: Report total failure
scenarios.description: Planning succeeds, then every report model request fails.

scenarios.label: Escalation request
scenarios.description: Asks the tier controller to escalate before inspecting the Vault.

speeds.description: Short delay for visible state changes.

speeds.label: Slow
speeds.description: Longer delay for loading and cancellation checks.
